headline: Chinese models dominate as DeepSeek, Zhipu AI, Tencent claim 56.7% of tokens
summary: The top three providers now command 56.7% of all tokens on OpenRouter, with DeepSeek and Zhipu AI alone holding 42.5%. Zhipu's flash variant vaulted to #1 despite a small daily dip, while DeepSeek v4.1-flash climbed three spots in a week to #2. Typesafe's jev-1.13 hit an all-time high on its second consecutive day at the top, and three new models entered the rankings as older variants fell away.
highlights: Zhipu AI's glm-5.3-flash-20260826 claims the #1 spot with 14.5% token share, up 6.1% over the week
DeepSeek v4.1-flash surges to #2 (14.4% share) after climbing 3 ranks in 7 days, though it shed 2.9% daily
Top three providers (DeepSeek, Zhipu AI, Tencent) control 56.7% of tokens; top five reach 71.5%
Typesafe's jev-1.13 sets an all-time token-share record at 1.3%, day 2 of the streak
Three new entrants: Xiaomi's mimo-v2.5-pro (#46), Qwen's qwen3.8-27b (#47), and xAI's grok-4.6 (#51)
DeepSeek provider share dropped 5.4% in one day but remains dominant at 24.8% overall
OpenAI fell 16.2% over the week to 9.4%, now in fourth place behind the Chinese trio
